text: {"sql":"SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status = '已完成' JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 3","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
